newsitem.title: MEXICO: TV Azteca IPO priced at $18.25 per ADS.
newsitem.headline: TV Azteca IPO priced at $18.25 per ADS.

text.p: Mexico broadcaster TV Azteca said the pricing for its initial public offering was $18.25 per ADS and 35.43 pesos per Mexican share.
"Based on the price (of $18.25 per ADS), the total offer of 345,998,013 shares represents 18.5 percent of TV Azteca's stock at a value of about $526 million," the company said.
Four CPO Mexican shares per ADS were assigned, the company said.
About 59 percent of the offer will be absorbed by U.S. investors, while 25.3 percent will go to the European market and 15.7 percent will be bought in Mexico, according to the statement.

On Friday Mexico's second largest broadcaster is due to simultaneously place stock on the Mexican stock market and the New York Stock Exchange. The initial public offering is one of Mexico's largest in recent years.
